name: goodreads-mcp
description: Read-only MCP server for Goodreads (no API required): search, books, shelves, ratings
long_description: Read-only MCP server for Goodreads — search books, fetch details/ratings histogram/series/review languages, paginated reviews via GraphQL, similar books, author bibliography, series order, editions, Listopia lists, popular by date, shelf RSS. No API key or login required; public data only.

goodreads_user_id.title: Goodreads User ID
goodreads_user_id.description: Numeric Goodreads profile ID (the number in goodreads.com/user/show/<ID>-name). Used as the default for shelf tools. Optional — can also be passed per tool call.
